name: Netori Shugisha no Hanayome Ijiri! ~Kon'yakusha ga Anna Koe de Aegu no o Aniki wa Shiranai~
original_name: 寝取主義者の花嫁弄り！ ～婚約者があんな声で喘ぐのを兄貴は知らない～
source: I frequently visited my hated older brother Kenichi's house because I wanted to see his fiancée, Miharu. She had all the qualities of a perfect wife: well-behaved, attractive, skilled in household chores and kind-hearted. Unlike the other women I had been involved with, she possessed the qualities of an ideal wife, which aroused me intensely. I wanted to completely possess and dominate her. The dark desire grew stronger every day. Then, I discovered a digital camera in her room, providing the perfect opportunity. She likely took the pictures out of curiosity. Among the happy photos of the couple, I found a few indecent pictures of Miharu engaging in masturbation. They were shockingly explicit and far beyond what I expected from her usual behavior, igniting my primal instincts. That alone was more than enough. I seized the chance to ruin everything. Brother, don't ever think you'll find happiness because that woman belongs to me. Their wedding is only two weeks away. Now, I eagerly anticipate how I will destroy their happiness.
translation: 我经常去我讨厌的哥哥健一的家，因为我想见他的未婚妻三春。她具备完美妻子的一切品质：乖巧、有魅力、能干家务、心地善良。与我接触过的其他女性不同，她拥有理想妻子的品质，这让我强烈地兴奋起来。我想彻底占有她、主宰她。黑暗的欲望一天比一天强烈。然后，我在她的房间里发现了一台数码相机，这提供了绝佳的机会。她拍这些照片可能是出于好奇。在这对情侣的幸福照片中，我发现了几张三春自慰的不雅照片。它们的露骨程度令人震惊，远远超出了我对她平时行为的预期，点燃了我的原始本能。仅此一点就足够了。我抓住了这个机会，毁掉了一切。兄弟，别以为那个女人是我的，你就能幸福。距离他们的婚礼只有两周了。现在，我热切地期待着我将如何摧毁他们的幸福。
